title: Haunted Dorm Clash
description: Dash into an empty dorm room, hop into bed to farm coins, reinforce your steel door, and build rapid-fire turrets before the prowling ghost breaks in.
controls: Drag to run into a dorm room and climb into bed, then tap empty floor tiles to construct and upgrade doors, generators, and turrets.

zh-CN.title: 猛鬼大作战
zh-CN.description: 超上头躺平发育宿舍塔防：开局狂奔进宿舍躺床发育、疯狂升级铁门与满屋炮塔，硬扛猛鬼猛砸宿舍门反杀通关！
zh-CN.controls: 拖动控制角色进入宿舍上床睡觉赚金币，点击房间空地建造并升级炮塔、大门与发电装置。
